author: Mattboxx
tagline: Share text and files between Windows, Android, iPhone and your server.
description: Share text, photos and file groups between Windows, Android and Apple Shortcuts. Includes persistent searchable history, optional separate accounts, browser access and a seven-language setup guide. No mandatory cloud account. Use a trusted LAN or private VPN; Apple actions are manual and Android background access is restricted.

tips.before_install: Use only on a trusted LAN or private VPN. Accounts and token are optional; credential URLs and HTTP are not encrypted. Keep /data persistent and back it up before updates. Open Connect your devices on the web page for setup instructions.

title: Clipboard Bridge
release_note: Seven-language web interface and login, device setup guide, website and tutorial links. Existing accounts, persistent data and Apple Shortcut URLs remain compatible.
